tokens.name: brand-teal
tokens.usage: Brand gradient start (top-left, 0%). Logo and gradient only; never text (2.7:1 on white).

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Brand gradient end (bottom-right, 100%). Also the solid fill of bars that carry text on the brand (public QR header); on-brand text 10:1.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: The gear of the mark and the name 'FixMyMedTech'. Logo only; the UI uses text.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text, mark and icons on brand-deep, brand-navy and the lower-right half of the gradient (5:1+). Never on the teal half.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind cards and the app shell.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, top bar, sidebar, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, row hover, neutral badges, recessed tiles.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between surfaces and rows. Decorative; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, selects, secondary buttons and pills (3.8:1 light, 3.9:1 dark on surface).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on bg, surface and sunken (12:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: All secondary text: labels, captions, table cells, timestamps, on bg, surface and sunken (5.4:1+ light, 7.6:1+ dark).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one action colour: primary buttons, links, active nav, focus ring. Text on surface and bg (5.1:1+ light, 6.5:1+ dark).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary fills and links.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Tinted fill for the active nav row and selected items, with primary text (4.7:1 light, 5.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and primary-hover fills.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Teal for emphasis text only: eyebrows, role labels, highlighted words. Text on surface and bg (4.9:1 light, 7:1 dark). Never a fill behind text.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Status: it works or is done (operational, resolved, closed). Text on ok-tint and surface.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind ok badges and success alerts (ok text 4.6:1 light, 7.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Status: someone is on it (assigned, diagnosed, approved, in progress, maintenance). Text on warn-tint and surface.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind warn badges, warning alerts and the out-of-service bar (warn text 4.5:1 light, 8.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Status: someone must act (open fault, fault, high or critical severity) and destructive buttons. Text on danger-tint and surface.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger badges, error alerts and danger buttons (danger text 5.3:1 light, 5.5:1 dark).

families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans", Ubuntu, Cantarell, "Adwaita Sans", sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Noto Sans Mono", monospace

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles and the device name on the public QR page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Fix, maintain and track your medical equipment.
styles.usage: All reading text and table cells. Buttons and nav links use it at weight 500.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Reported 3 days ago by Amina K.
styles.usage: Labels, captions, help text, badges. As an eyebrow: uppercase, 0.06em tracking, text-muted or accent.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Serial numbers, asset tags, short device ids on QR tags. Nothing else is set in mono.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside badges; icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons and toolbar items; label to field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between cards in a grid; table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter; card padding on phones; between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; desktop side gutter; under the page title.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Clear space around a stand-alone logo; sign-in panel padding.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, alerts, nav rows.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, menus, QR tags.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges and filter pills.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards; the border does most of the work.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Anything that floats: menus, suggestions, modals.

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: Height of the fixed top bar.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar; 64px when folded.

tokens.name: page-narrow
tokens.usage: Max width of phone-first pages: public QR page, sign-in form.
